item.title: ✖️ Chris Perruna Wins and losses are equally a part of investing. The net result
item.description:
✖️ Chris Perruna

Wins and losses are equally a part of investing. The net result is ALL that matters.

"If you haven't found that place in yourself, then it's very hard to accept losses. And if you cannot accept the negative consequences, you'll never succeed as a trader" - Tharp

"Most successful speculators have a success rate below 50%" - Tharp

The biggest indicator of a phony investor on X is that fact that they have to be right vs admitting their losses.
